description: This file defines a wizard in the OpenERP (Odoo) framework for generating VAT listing XML files for Belgian partners, including form definitions, data processing, and XML generation logic.

classes.name: wizard_vat
classes.description: Wizard class for creating VAT listing XML files, handling form actions and XML data generation.

methods.name: _create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML file with VAT details for Belgian partners based on form input, including data retrieval, XML string construction, and encoding.
